meta.title: Find Your Treatment | Rosemary Esthetics, Idaho Falls
meta.description: Answer three quick questions and get a personal treatment recommendation from the Rosemary Esthetics menu: facials, lashes, brows, waxing, or back.

hero.heading: Find Your Treatment
hero.lead: Three quick questions and we'll point you to the service your skin is asking for. No email required, just an honest recommendation.

questions.prompt: What's your main goal right now?
options: Smooth, glowing skin for an event

questions.prompt: How much time do you have?

quiz.error_message: Please answer all three questions first.
quiz.extra_clear_goal: Ask about adding LED light therapy, new at the studio and just $5, to support clear, calm skin.

back_clear.name: Back Reset Treatment
back_clear.why: A deep-cleansing back facial that targets congestion and breakouts in all the spots you can’t reach.

back_relax.name: Heated Stone Back Treatment
back_relax.why: Deep cleansing plus warm stone massage over the back and shoulders. The most relaxing hour on the menu.

smooth.name: Full Face Wax
smooth.why: Quick, gentle waxing with soothing aftercare, smooth results that outlast shaving by weeks.

eyes_long.name: Eyebrow and Eyelash Package
eyes_long.why: Lash lift and tint plus brow lamination and tint in one visit, the full eye-opening refresh at a bundle price.

eyes_short.name: Eyelash Lift
eyes_short.why: Your natural lashes, curled from the root in half an hour. Zero daily effort for 6–8 weeks.

eyes_medium.name: Eyelash Lift and Tint
eyes_medium.why: Lifted and darkened natural lashes, like waking up with mascara on, for 6–8 weeks.

event_long.name: Smooth + Glow Facial (Dermaplane)
event_long.why: Dermaplaning removes peach fuzz and dead skin so you glow in photos and makeup applies flawlessly.

event_short.name: Skin Reset Facial
event_short.why: A fast, effective mini facial to brighten and refresh before the big day.

event_medium.name: Signature Facial
event_medium.why: A fully customized facial to cleanse, exfoliate, and restore that lit-from-within look.

default_short.name: Skin Reset Facial
default_short.why: A quick but complete mini facial, perfect for maintenance between fuller appointments.

default_long_relax.name: Signature Facial + Gua Sha
default_long_relax.why: The customized Signature Facial with gua sha sculpting added on. Pure calm, from the first cleanse to the last massage stroke.

default_long_other.name: Smooth + Glow Facial (Dermaplane)
default_long_other.why: The deepest refresh on the menu, dermaplaning plus a fully customized facial.

default_medium.name: Signature Facial
default_medium.why: A fully customized facial built around your skin and your goals, our most loved service.
